name: Thakurdwara

queries.query: Thakurdwara Uttar Pradesh official cadastral map land records GIS parcel map
queries.result: First-party results identified the Board of Revenue Uttar Pradesh land-record portal, the official UP Bhu-Naksha viewer, and the UP cadastral-map digitization dashboard. The current Bhu-Naksha JavaScript viewer was followed to its public service and returned administrative level codes, a village map extent, CRS metadata, and bounded safe plot ID/bounding-box responses.

queries.query: ठाकुरद्वारा उत्तर प्रदेश आधिकारिक भू नक्शा खसरा नक्शा
queries.result: First-party Hindi results identified Rajस्व परिषद Uttar Pradesh land-record and Bhu-Naksha services. The official viewer returned Moradabad (135), Thakurdwara tehsil (00717), and same-named revenue village (220917) records; no anonymous full polygon response was obtained.

officialSources.observation: Official Uttar Pradesh Bhu-Naksha public viewer. Its current JavaScript configuration exposed the public service base https://upbhunaksha.gov.in/bhunakshaserver and level-value, extent, plot lookup, and plot-by-ID routes.
Official Board of Revenue Uttar Pradesh land-record portal describing online land records and linked Bhu-Naksha services.
Official Uttar Pradesh cadastral-map digitization dashboard; it reports linked/geo-referenced Bhu-Naksha coverage at state and district reporting levels, not a citywide parcel inventory.
Official Revenue Council page listing Khasra, Khatauni, Bhu-Naksha/Shajra, village-map, and gata-boundary services.

requests.outcome: Viewer shell loaded. Current main JavaScript was inspected for the public API base, endpoint paths, level sequence, and CRS support.

Anonymous level discovery returned district 135=मुरादाबाद, tehsil 00717=ठाकुरद्वारा, and village 220917=ठाकुरद्वारा. A preliminary wrong state-code request returned an empty list; this was treated only as route probing, not as absence evidence.

Returned gisCode 13500717220917, extent xmin=290917.0139367361, ymin=3230351.2349705785, xmax=292057.10039685504, ymax=3231706.902661109, attribution naming Moradabad/Thakurdwara/Thakurdwara, and CRS EPSG:32644.

Bounded anonymous lookup returned safe plot identity kide=47 and native opaque id fe7uq8tJS_-m_oqw0Cf6Lg with a UTM bounding box. This probe was deliberately away from the WUP point and is not retained as a parcel polygon.

Bounded anonymous lookup returned safe plot identity kide=1 and native opaque id aiNDmvS5TyupDnHL6PkS2g with a UTM bounding box. No owner, address, contact, title, tax, or other unsafe field was requested.
Public plot-by-ID route responded Missing or invalid Authorization header. No token, login, credential, CAPTCHA, Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe alternative was attempted.
Official dashboard loaded; used as coverage/procedure evidence only.

registryBasis: The official Uttar Pradesh Board of Revenue land-record/Bhu-Naksha service and its public Moradabad-Thakurdwara village map establish a state/local revenue cadastral custodian and an actual public map procedure. They do not establish citywide parcel coverage for the WUP city point.

nativeFieldMapping.id: opaque native Bhu-Naksha plot id returned by public lookup; stable identity not independently qualified
nativeFieldMapping.kide: native plot/gata number returned by public lookup
nativeFieldMapping.minx/miny/maxx/maxy: native EPSG:32644 bounding-box fields from anonymous lookup; not a full parcel geometry

compositeKeyProvenance: Administrative path 135/00717/220917 was used to form public gisCode 13500717220917; it is service navigation provenance, not a synthetic parcel identity.
crs: EPSG:32644 (UTM zone 44N, WGS84) reported by official extent response; no full parcel geometry was retrieved.
geometryQuality: not evaluated; only bounding boxes were returned anonymously

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Uttar Pradesh Board of Revenue Bhu-Naksha land-record map service for the selected revenue village.
coverageAssessment.cityCoverage: The selected same-named revenue village map extent is documented, but it is not shown to cover the full Thakurdwara WUP city. The exact WUP point transforms to approximately UTM 44N [298786.08,3232455.82], outside the returned extent; this map-extent miss is not treated as citywide absence.
coverageAssessment.note: The exact WUP point [29.2048542395257, 78.9302902436794] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted. Its derived UTM coordinate was used only to compare with the official returned extent.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only, if independently confirmed
source layer and public service metadata
native plot/gata number only when needed for public parcel identity
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review still required
uncertainty: The public viewer and administrative path are real and reproducible, but anonymous full geometry is blocked by the plot-by-ID Authorization requirement. The WUP point is outside the selected village-map extent, and citywide service coverage, parcel-layer completeness, native identity stability, update currency, and legal boundary status remain unresolved. No raw source-specific attribute set or synthetic row identity was retained. This packet is not source integration/admission.
